EC1: - Subject has an implanted medical device that delivers electrical energy to the brain.
EC2: - Subject has an implantable cardiac pacemaker, [OR] defibrillator, [OR] or neurostimulator.
EC3: - Subject is likely to require repeat MR imaging after implant of the RNS Neurostimulator [OR] and Leads.
EC4: - Subject is [NOT] unable to fit into CT scanner (500lb upper weight limit for CT scanner).
EC5: - Inability to provide informed consent to treatment.
